# AI Fill Drawer

## Summary
A record-details drawer that lists a record's fields as key/value rows and lets the model fill the empty values. "Fill with AI" fills every empty field at once. Each value arrives on its own as a marked suggestion, with the source it came from, and only becomes the record's real value once the user accepts or edits it. Values the user already set are never touched.

## When to use
- Enrichment: CRM accounts, contacts, products, tickets or assets where many fields can be found from the web, documents or connected tools.
- Records opened from a table row, where the drawer keeps the table in view for context.
- Any form where most fields are guessable and the user's job is to check, not type.

## When not to use
- Fields whose value is a decision, not a fact: owner, stage, price, approval. Mark them not fillable.
- Identifiers and legal or regulated data (tax IDs, contract terms) where a plausible wrong value is worse than an empty one.
- Bulk enrichment of hundreds of rows. Run a background job and review the result in the table instead.
- Long free-text fields. A drafted description or note belongs in an editor with Refinement Controls, not a one-line value cell.

## Anatomy
- **Header** — record title, a one-line subtitle (type, created date), close.
- **Action bar** — "Fill with AI" (becomes "Stop" while running) and a status line ("4 empty", "Filling 3 fields…", "All fields have values").
- **Field list** — a definition list: muted key on the left, value on the right. A row can be:
  - **Set** — plain value, click to edit.
  - **Empty** — muted "Empty"; on hover or focus, a per-field ✦ fill button.
  - **Filling** — a pulsing skeleton bar in place of the value.
  - **Suggested** — a tinted row, ✦ before the value, "from <source>" underneath, and accept ✓ / reject × buttons.
  - **Not found** — italic "Couldn't find a value" with a retry button.
- **Review footer** — slides up once filling ends and suggestions remain: "3 AI values to review · Reject all · Accept all".

## Behavior
- "Fill with AI" requests every empty, fillable field in parallel. Rows resolve independently, in whatever order the answers arrive. Don't hold all of them back until the slowest finishes.
- Only empty fields are filled. A value the user set — or accepted — is never overwritten by a later fill.
- Stop cancels the run: rows still filling go back to Empty, and late answers from that run are ignored. Suggestions that already arrived stay.
- A suggestion is not the record's value until it is accepted. `onChange` fires only on accept or on an edit.
- Accept turns the row into a plain set value. Reject empties it again and leaves it fillable.
- Clicking any value, including a suggestion, edits it inline. Enter or blur saves, Esc cancels. Saving an edited suggestion counts as accepting the user's value.
- When the model finds nothing, say so ("Couldn't find a value") instead of guessing. Retry is per field.
- The review footer is hidden while filling, so Accept all can't accept a half-finished set.
- Esc closes the drawer, unless focus is in a field editor.

## Content guidelines
- Keys are short nouns in the record's own vocabulary ("Headquarters", not "Company HQ location").
- Suggested values use the same format the field would use if typed: ranges like "1,001–5,000", bare domains, no sentences.
- Always show a source when the model has one — a page, a document, a tool. "Web search" is acceptable; no source at all should be rare.
- The status line counts, never apologizes: "2 empty", not "We couldn't fill 2 fields".

## Accessibility
- Fields are a `<dl>` of `<dt>`/`<dd>` pairs, so screen readers announce key and value together.
- Each value is a button labelled "Edit <field>"; the inline input is labelled by its key.
- Accept, reject, fill and retry are icon buttons with full labels ("Accept AI value for Industry").
- The ✦ marker has an accessible label ("AI suggestion"), and the tinted row is never the only signal — the accept/reject buttons and the source line also mark it.
- The status line is a polite live region, so progress ("Filling 3 fields…") and completion are announced.
- The drawer takes focus when opened. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, it fades instead of sliding.

## Related patterns
- **Describe Filters** — Use it as well, since it's the table this drawer is usually opened from.
- **Confidence Indicator** — Use it as well next to a suggestion when the model can report how sure it is.
- **Source Trust Card** — Use it as well to expand a suggestion's source into a full preview.
- **Background Tasks Drawer** — Use it instead when the drawer tracks long-running work rather than suggested values.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { Check, RotateCcw, Sparkles, Square, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface FieldDef {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** A value the user (or system) already set. `null` means empty. */
  value: string | null;
  /** Set false for fields the model must never fill (IDs, owners, legal names…). */
  fillable?: boolean;
}

export interface FillResult {
  /** `null` when the model couldn't find a value it trusts. */
  value: string | null;
  /** Where the value came from — shown under the suggestion. */
  source?: string;
}

type FieldState =
  | { status: "set"; value: string }
  | { status: "empty" }
  | { status: "filling" }
  | { status: "suggested"; value: string; source?: string }
  | { status: "missing" };

export interface AiFillDrawerProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  fields: FieldDef[];
  /** Fills a single field. Called once per empty, fillable field. */
  onFill: (key: string) => Promise<FillResult>;
  /** Fires whenever a value is committed — typed, or an accepted suggestion. */
  onChange?: (key: string, value: string | null) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const initialState = (f: FieldDef): FieldState =>
  f.value ? { status: "set", value: f.value } : { status: "empty" };

export function AiFillDrawer({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  subtitle,
  fields,
  onFill,
  onChange,
  className,
}: AiFillDrawerProps) {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<Record<string, FieldState>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f) => [f.key, initialState(f)]))
  );
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  /** Bumped by Stop — results from an older run are dropped. */
  const run = React.useRef(0);
  const panelRef = React.useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const wasOpen = React.useRef(open);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const justOpened = open && !wasOpen.current;
    wasOpen.current = open;
    if (!open) return;
    if (justOpened) panelRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && !(e.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) onClose();
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  const patch = (key: string, next: FieldState) => setState((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: next }));

  const isFillable = (f: FieldDef) => f.fillable !== false;
  const fillableEmpty = fields.filter(
    (f) => isFillable(f) && (state[f.key].status === "empty" || state[f.key].status === "missing")
  );
  const filling = fields.filter((f) => state[f.key].status === "filling");
  const suggested = fields.filter((f) => state[f.key].status === "suggested");
  const busy = filling.length > 0;

  function fill(keys: string[]) {
    const id = run.current;
    for (const key of keys) {
      patch(key, { status: "filling" });
      onFill(key)
        .then((r) => {
          if (run.current !== id) return;
          patch(key, r.value ? { status: "suggested", value: r.value, source: r.source } : { status: "missing" });
        })
        .catch(() => run.current === id && patch(key, { status: "missing" }));
    }
  }

  function stop() {
    run.current += 1;
    setState((s) =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(s).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.status === "filling" ? { status: "empty" } : v])
      )
    );
  }

  function commit(key: string, value: string | null) {
    patch(key, value ? { status: "set", value } : { status: "empty" });
    onChange?.(key, value);
  }

  function accept(key: string) {
    const s = state[key];
    if (s.status === "suggested") commit(key, s.value);
  }

  function reject(key: string) {
    patch(key, { status: "empty" });
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.aside
          ref={panelRef}
          tabIndex={-1}
          aria-label={title}
          initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { x: "100%", opacity: 0.6 }}
          animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { x: "100%", opacity: 0.6 }}
          transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 380, damping: 38 }}
          className={cn(
            "flex h-full w-full max-w-sm flex-col overflow-hidden border-l bg-background text-sm shadow-xl outline-none",
            className
          )}
        >
          <header className="flex items-start gap-2 px-5 pb-3 pt-4">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 className="truncate font-medium">{title}</h2>
              {subtitle && <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{subtitle}</p>}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close"
              className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <X className="size-4" />
            </button>
          </header>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-5 pb-3">
            {busy ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={stop}
                className="flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-foreground/10 bg-muted"
              >
                <Square className="size-3 fill-current" aria-hidden />
                Stop
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fill(fillableEmpty.map((f) => f.key))}
                disabled={fillableEmpty.length === 0}
                className="flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-foreground/10 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-transparent bg-muted"
              >
                <Sparkles className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                Fill with AI
              </button>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" role="status" aria-live="polite">
              {busy
                ? `Filling ${filling.length} field${filling.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}…`
                : fillableEmpty.length > 0
                  ? `${fillableEmpty.length} empty`
                  : "All fields have values"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <dl className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto px-2 py-3">
            {fields.map((f) => (
              <FieldRow
                key={f.key}
                field={f}
                state={state[f.key]}
                editing={editing === f.key}
                onEdit={() => setEditing(f.key)}
                onEditDone={(value) => {
                  setEditing(null);
                  if (value !== undefined) commit(f.key, value);
                }}
                onFill={() => fill([f.key])}
                onAccept={() => accept(f.key)}
                onReject={() => reject(f.key)}
              />
            ))}
          </dl>

          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {suggested.length > 0 && !busy && (
              <motion.footer
                initial={{ y: 12, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ y: 12, opacity: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t bg-muted/40 px-5 py-3"
              >
                <span className="flex-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {suggested.length} AI value{suggested.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => suggested.forEach((f) => reject(f.key))}
                  className="h-8 rounded-full px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground"
                >
                  Reject all
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => suggested.forEach((f) => accept(f.key))}
                  className="h-8 rounded-full bg-primary px-3 text-xs font-medium text-primary-foreground transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
                >
                  Accept all
                </button>
              </motion.footer>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </motion.aside>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

function FieldRow({
  field,
  state,
  editing,
  onEdit,
  onEditDone,
  onFill,
  onAccept,
  onReject,
}: {
  field: FieldDef;
  state: FieldState;
  editing: boolean;
  onEdit: () => void;
  /** `undefined` = cancelled. */
  onEditDone: (value?: string | null) => void;
  onFill: () => void;
  onAccept: () => void;
  onReject: () => void;
}) {
  const labelId = React.useId();
  // The input blurs as it unmounts after Enter/Esc; only the first exit counts.
  const exited = React.useRef(false);
  function exit(value?: string | null) {
    if (exited.current) return;
    exited.current = true;
    onEditDone(value);
  }
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (editing) exited.current = false;
  }, [editing]);
  const suggested = state.status === "suggested";
  const current = state.status === "set" || state.status === "suggested" ? state.value : "";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "group grid grid-cols-[7.5rem_1fr] items-start gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-colors",
        suggested && "bg-muted/60"
      )}
    >
      <dt id={labelId} className="truncate pt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {field.label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="min-w-0">
        {editing ? (
          <input
            autoFocus
            defaultValue={current}
            aria-labelledby={labelId}
            onBlur={(e) => exit(e.target.value.trim() || null)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") exit(e.currentTarget.value.trim() || null);
              if (e.key === "Escape") {
                e.preventDefault();
                exit(undefined);
              }
            }}
            className="h-8 w-full rounded-lg px-2 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring/40 bg-muted focus:bg-background"
          />
        ) : (
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
            <motion.div
              key={state.status}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 3 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.16 }}
              className="flex min-h-8 items-start gap-1"
            >
              {state.status === "filling" ? (
                <span className="flex h-8 flex-1 items-center" aria-label="Filling">
                  <span className="h-3 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/15" />
                </span>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onEdit}
                    aria-label={`Edit ${field.label}`}
                    className="-mx-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                  >
                    {state.status === "set" || state.status === "suggested" ? (
                      <span className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        {suggested && (
                          <Sparkles className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-label="AI suggestion" />
                        )}
                        <span className="break-words">{state.value}</span>
                      </span>
                    ) : state.status === "missing" ? (
                      <span className="italic text-muted-foreground">Couldn&apos;t find a value</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">Empty</span>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  {suggested && (
                    <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center">
                      <IconButton label={`Accept AI value for ${field.label}`} onClick={onAccept}>
                        <Check className="size-3.5" />
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton label={`Reject AI value for ${field.label}`} onClick={onReject}>
                        <X className="size-3.5" />
                      </IconButton>
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {(state.status === "empty" || state.status === "missing") && field.fillable !== false && (
                    <IconButton
                      label={`${state.status === "missing" ? "Retry" : "Fill"} ${field.label} with AI`}
                      onClick={onFill}
                      className="opacity-0 group-focus-within:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100"
                    >
                      {state.status === "missing" ? <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" /> : <Sparkles className="size-3.5" />}
                    </IconButton>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          </AnimatePresence>
        )}
        {suggested && state.source && !editing && (
          <p className="truncate pt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">from {state.source}</p>
        )}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function IconButton({
  label,
  onClick,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className={cn(
        "flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```
